sourceCode: copyFrom: start to: stop   "Answer a copy of a subset of the receiver, starting from element at	index start until element at index stop."   | newSize |   newSize := stop - start + 1.   ^ (self species newTenured: newSize)        replaceFrom: 1        to: newSize        with: self        startingAt: start
